args: set -a; [ -f "$HOME/.env" ] && . "$HOME/.env"; set +a; exec nix shell nixpkgs#uv --command uvx --from local-deep-research ldr-mcp
local-deep-research.description: Open-source, self-hosted Perplexity-style research MCP (replaces Perplexity). Supports academic search (arXiv, PubMed, Semantic Scholar) and web sources. CAVEAT: requires local setup — install/configure Local Deep Research and a search/LLM backend (see https://github.com/LearningCircuit/local-deep-research/blob/main/docs/mcp-server.md); first run may be heavy and needs models/providers configured. Not a drop-in hosted API like Perplexity.

bitwarden.description: Bitwarden vault/password access via official MCP server. Requires Bitwarden CLI auth: set BW_SESSION (from 'bw unlock --raw') or BW_CLIENTID/BW_CLIENTSECRET/BW_PASSWORD for API/self-hosted auth. Local stdio only; never expose publicly.
